pages.text: Press $(bold)J$() to open the config screen — you can tune most of the pacing:$(br)Want to get sweaty faster? Shorten the wear-time thresholds.$(br)Find fungus annoying? You can disable fungus, its damage, its spread and the smell entirely.$(br)Soak durations, boot-rinsing time, drink buff lengths and level-2 sliding are all adjustable too.

$(bold)Visuals$(): sweat drops, sneezes and the sitting undress effect can be toggled individually; the skin color used while sitting is picked here with the eyedropper.$(br2)Config is split in two: $(bold)server settings$() are decided by the host and apply to everyone; $(bold)client settings$() (visuals, picked color) are per-player.
